text:
Aisha (PM): Kicking off a small 'onramp play' for design partners next month — 6 customers, 2-week pilots, goal: validate Dedicated onboarding friction & rollout docs. Need recruitment + feedback loop plan. Thoughts?

Jon (Product): Love it. Suggest 3 priority signals for recruiting: infra (Private/VPC), latency-sensitive apps, usage >10k tokens/day. Can we get SE to nominate customers?

Maya (Eng-RE): Also need a sample config + runbook for SRE handoff. Can we limit model variants to 2 (base + quant) to reduce support surface?

Devon (SE): @Aisha I can pull a shortlist from post-sales CRM; want intros or full NDR? Also volunteer to run 1:1 onboarding demos.

Aisha (PM): Yes @Devon intros first. We'll ask for a 30-min intake + weekly async feedback via a short form. Success metrics: time-to-first-infer < 10min, error-free rollout >= 90%, qualitative rating >= 4/5.

Jon (Product): :thumbsup: Can we add a probe: sample prompt-set evaluation artifacts (5 prompts) to detect quality regressions?

Maya (Eng-RE): Agreed. I'll prepare a minimal eval harness and a sample prompt file. Quick config snippet for invites:
```yaml
model_variants: [gpt-mini, gpt-mini-quant]
region: us-west2
onboard_window_days: 14
```

Devon (SE): What about data security asks? Some partners want KMS + audit logs. Need to surface which DP need Private.

Aisha (PM): Callout added — filter for 'requires KMS' in shortlist. Also we should offer a dedicated Slack channel per partner and weekly 30m sync.

pm-bot: Reminder: create calendar invites and onboarding docs in Notion by EOD Fri.

Jon (Product): I'll own the invite templates and the brief. Can we run a dry-run w/ internal ops next Tues?

Aisha (PM): Yes — dry-run Tues 10am. @everyone add blockers below. Thanks!
